title: Windows from the same parent application, including different web apps from the same browser, all show the same media preview and controls
line: When a browser plays media, the task tooltips of its other windows and web apps no longer show the media controls of the playing one.
explanation: A browser exposes one media player for all its windows, and the task manager looks that player up by process, so every ungrouped window tooltip of the browser (including its web apps) got the same media controls and volume slider. The grouped tooltip already used the window titles to pick the playing window, but the single-window tooltip never did. The single tooltip now checks whether any window of the same process has the track in its title; if one does, only that window shows the controls. If none does, nothing changes.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show media controls only on the window playing

Ungrouped task tooltips showed the media controls on every window of the
same process, such as all windows and web apps of a browser. Now, if one
of its windows has the track in its title, only that one shows them.

BUG: 504234

media.caption: Chrome, ungrouped: the tooltip of the quiet window shows the 'Test Tone' controls playing in the other window
Same setup with the fix: the quiet window's tooltip has no media controls

review.text: Reuses the grouped tooltip's existing title-matching heuristic for the single-window tooltip, which is the only window/player hint browsers give, and leaves behaviour unchanged when no title matches. Replacing the album-art condition with titleIncludesTrack is consistent and arguably fixes the grouped case too. The loop over tasksModel.data() won't re-evaluate on other windows' title changes, but tooltips are rebuilt on hover, so it's acceptable.
